messages.author: Nadia Bouzid
messages.text: Nadia: Does anyone know the deadline for payroll changes for our French clients? I can't find a document.

messages.author: Julien Moreau
messages.text: Julien: For French payrolls, payroll changes must reach us 6 working days before payday. We don't have a written procedure yet, it's on my to do list.
